title: Frog reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#4ec44e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <!-- frog head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#3fbf3f'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='32' r='10' fill='#3fbf3f'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='32' r='10' fill='#3fbf3f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='31' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='31' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='32' r='4' fill='#1a1a4e'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='32' r='4' fill='#1a1a4e'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 52 Q50 62 60 52' stroke='#2a9a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3fbf3f' transform='rotate(-20 20 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='68' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3fbf3f' transform='rotate(20 80 68)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='26' y='60' width='48' height='30' rx='3' fill='#e04040'/>
  <rect x='29' y='63' width='20' height='24' rx='2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='63' width='20' height='24' rx='2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#c03030' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- text lines -->
  <line x1='32' y1='68' x2='46' y2='68' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='73' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='78' x2='44' y2='78' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='68' x2='68' y2='68' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='68' y2='73' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='78' x2='66' y2='78' stroke='#b0a080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='88' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#3fbf3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='88' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#3fbf3f'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='90' r='3' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='90' r='3' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='90' r='3' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='90' r='3' fill='#7ee87e'/>
</svg>
